I found 2 issues in test 20261121-061202-2158. The record's seal is intact, the audit shows no breaks, and `findings.json` lists no findings.

- **Turn 2 was too slow:** it took 60.1 seconds, and the limit is 30. Most of that time came after the reply was ready: two case-note calls to the note model took 25 seconds each, one after the other. The stock check also took 8 seconds.
- **Turn 3 made an unbacked claim:** the reply said the order "may ship soon". The order lookup only returned "waiting for stock", and nothing in the records or rules links stock on hand to when a waiting order ships.

Everything else checked out: the right tools were called with the right arguments, and the stock numbers and order details match the app's saved data. No limit, persona or boundary rule was broken. The tester left no notes, and a proxy saw every outside service the app called.

The report is at `.nookku/tests/20261121-061202-2158/report.md`.
